Despite a 55% return on the stock over the past year, InvestingPro analysis suggests the shares are currently overvalued. The company recently exceeded Q4 earnings expectations and increased its share repurchase authorization by $5 billion, contributing to a positive analyst outlook.

stories.title: Cardinal Health CEO Deborah Weitzman sells $1.73m in shares By Investing.com
stories.summary: Deborah Weitzman, CEO of Cardinal Health Inc.’s PSS Segment, sold common shares worth $1.73 million on August 18, 2026. Following these transactions, she retains 77,901 shares, while the stock has seen a significant increase over the past year and is considered undervalued by InvestingPro. This sale comes as Cardinal Health reported strong fiscal year 2026 results and received positive analyst ratings.
